purpose_text.para: Holds the timer value for the EL1 virtual timer.

field_description.para: The TimerValue view of the EL1 virtual timer.
On a read of this register:

listitem.content: If CNTV_CTL_EL0.ENABLE is 0, the value returned is UNKNOWN.
If CNTV_CTL_EL0.ENABLE is 1, the value returned is (CNTV_CVAL_EL0 - CNTVCT_EL0).

field_description.para: On a write of this register, CNTV_CVAL_EL0 is set to (CNTVCT_EL0 + TimerValue), where TimerValue is treated as a signed 32-bit integer.

When CNTV_CTL_EL0.ENABLE is 1, the timer condition is met when (CNTVCT_EL0 - CNTV_CVAL_EL0) is greater than or equal to zero. This means that TimerValue acts like a 32-bit downcounter timer. When the timer condition is met:

listitem.content: If CNTV_CTL_EL0.IMASK is 0, an interrupt is generated.

field_description.para: When CNTV_CTL_EL0.ENABLE is 0, the TimerValue cannot be read but continues to decrement. When the timer is enabled, the TimerValue represents the elapsed time whether that time was spent enabled or disabled.

access_permission_text.para: When the Effective value of HCR_EL2.E2H is 1, without explicit synchronization, accesses from EL3 using the accessor name CNTV_TVAL_EL0 or CNTV_TVAL_EL02 are not guaranteed to be ordered with respect to accesses using the other accessor name.
